components.gap: Relational side: matched Henkin models and adequacy through the incidence encoding and extensional-collapse decoding are present, but derivability is defined as the translation, so no soundness/completeness of a natively generated calculus is proved: Prove completeness of the native finite generator list displayed on sheet:sol (LK with equality plus the four relation-quantifier rules and the Comp/Choice schema families) by a converse deductive-correspondence theorem; def:p02-sol-native-boundary (supplement lines 246-254) states this is not proved, and derivability is currently defined as the translation (supplement lines 175-228). Typed side: Define Henkin/general models for the selected typed higher-order system (Church's, with descriptions 9, extensionality 10 and choice 11) and prove its soundness and completeness through an exact first-order encoding and decoding with nonempty sorts and extensionality; the owned files give only the standard (full) model and soundness for it (body lines 413-477, 613-616), and the host simple-type chapter only cites Henkin's theorem (restoration 12784 lines 58-67) and states an internal proof boundary (lines 109-117).

Full semantics, its nonaxiomatizability and its distinction from Henkin completeness are present, subject to: Write the course-of-values recognition clauses for the four second-order tags N_15-N_18 of def:p02-w02-p02-040-so-coding (arity match of X^n atoms with their argument lists, free relation-variable lists, sentencehood), proving that the set of codes of second-order sentences is decidable as used by clauses 4-5 of thm:p02-w02-p02-040-no-effective-calculus; annex lines 779-782 assert that 'the same recursion, extended by the four tags', decides it without writing the extension. Not supplied: the completeness obligation for the imported typed HOL rule surface (Church's Rules I-VI and Axioms 1-11 relative to general models) and the completeness obligation for the native rule list on sheet:sol (def:p02-sol-native-boundary states it is unproved).

Composite: GOAL-01 is covered; GOAL-02 and GOAL-03 are partial with the duties stated there (typed general models with soundness and completeness through first-order encoding/decoding; native sheet:sol completeness; typed HOL completeness obligation; decidability of second-order sentence codes).
